description: Launch, activate, hide, unhide or quit an app (display name, bundle id, or .app path). launch: attaches to a running instance (activate:true brings it forward), else starts it in the background unless activate:true and waits for a window (wait_window, default true). quit: graceful, verified by the process ending (a save dialog keeps it running — reported); force:true force-quits and loses unsaved work. Finder, Dock, loginwindow and other session processes, and the MCP host itself, are never quit. launch with cdp_port (0 = pick a free port; needs NORACU_ALLOW_CDP=1) starts a Chromium/Electron app fresh with a loopback DevTools port for browser_launch cdp_port — refused if the app is already running.
name: mac_app
